summary: Comprehensive remediation plan covering all 6 audit findings across database correctness, scalability, and wire-payload efficiency: safe partial index updates without clobbering searchTokens or dedupeKey, multi-term and series-aware unified catalog search with per-library fallback, native filtered pagination cursor alignment and targeted legacy status fallback, userRatings unioning during duplicate merges, bounded subcollection cleanup and orphan-free bookDetails deletion on library removal, and stripping searchTokens from client payloads in favor of a lightweight hasSearchTokens flag.
